spans.s: skambha (LL), a post or pillar; cf. dīpa-skambha (LL), a lamp post. Same as Kannaḍa kamba, kamma. Cf. stambha.
Skandaka (HD), a petty officer; probably the head of the village administration. See Rājataraṅgiṇī,
skandaka (Ind. Ant., Vol. XIII, p. 69), an instalment; cf. skandha.
skandhaka (EI 3; HRS), known from Gujara-Pratīhāra records; name of a tax; probably, a cess at a certain rate per shoulder-load.
skandhāvāra (EI 29; CII 3; BL), camp; usually called jaya-skandhāvāra (i. e. the victorious camp) which indicates the capital of a king in some cases. Cf. Kannaḍa neleviḍu = Sanskrit sthira-śibira.
